headlines.description: — Derek Hill hit a go-ahead grand slam in the seventh inning and Bryce Harper added a two-run shot to lift the Philadelphia Phillies to their third straight win, 6-3 over the Washington...
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Hill rallies Phillies with go-ahead grand slam in 7th in 6-3 win over Nationals

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Alec Burleson hit three two-run homers, including a drive into the second deck in right field that capped a seven-run eighth inning as the St. Louis Cardinals outslugged the New York Yankees for a 13-7 victory Monday night after blowing a six-run lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alec Burleson hits 3 homers as Cardinals outslug Yankees 13-7 after losing 6-run lead

headlines.description: — Spencer Horwitz hit a three-run double and the Pittsburgh Pirates extended their dominance over the Brewers this season, beating Milwaukee 4-3 on Monday night in the opener of a four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Horwitz drives in 3 runs, Pirates defeat Brewers for the 6th time in 7 games this season

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Jung Hoo Lee hit two solo homers and drove in three RBI and Logan Webb pitched six shutout innings as the San Francisco Giants beat the scuffling Texas Rangers 5-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lee homers twice, Webb tosses 6 shutout innings as Giants deal Rangers 6th straight loss

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Seiya Suzuki, Carson Kelly and Kevin Alcántara each hit a two-run homer, and the Chicago Cubs handed the Los Angeles Dodgers their fourth consecutive loss with a 10-5 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seiya Suzuki and Carson Kelly star as the Cubs beat the slumping Dodgers 10-5

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Alejandro Kirk homered, Jesús Sánchez and Ernie Clement each had an RBI and the Toronto Blue Jays beat Houston 3-1 on Monday night, snapping the Astros' six-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk goes deep as the Blue Jays snap the Astros’ 6-game streak in a 3-1 win

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero hit two home runs, Jonathan Aranda had four hits and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Colorado Rockies 13-9 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero hits 2 homers, Jonathan Aranda gets 4 hits and Rays beat Rockies 13-9

events.name: San Diego Padres at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Tim Tawa hit a three-run homer and Brandon Pfaadt carried a shutout into the seventh inning as the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the San Diego Padres 5-1 Monday night in the opener of a 10-game homestand against NL West rivals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pfaadt, Tawa lead Diamondbacks past Padres 5-1 in NL wild-card position matchup
